name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Shows progress through a multi-step flow or checklist, with done, current, waiting and failed steps.

when: A flow of three or more steps: checkout, signup, setup.

instead.when: Only the share done matters, not named steps.
People move freely between views in any order.

builtIn: The current step has aria-current; the list is named with the overall progress.

genui.description: Steps of a flow. steps are {id, label, description?}; currentStep is the id of the step in progress.
